notes.title: Demo Update 5/17/2024 (1 of 2)
notes.content:
I would like to start this off by apologizing for my absence. I've been super busy with my daughter being born and dealing with real-life stuff. But I have been working on the game in my free time and will continue to work on it! I've been picking up the pace a bit more and am hoping to spend more time on the game than I have in the past few weeks. Thank you all for your patience! That said, let's get into it! 

I've made a few changes to the game, which include:

🕹️ Keybinding Menu: You can now rebind keybinds!

🎯 Mouse/Controller Aim Sensitivity: Options to adjust sensitivity.

🎮 Controller Rumble/Vibration: Added vibration feedback.

🏹 Bow Lock-On (Controller Only): Ability to lock on while using a bow.

🔄 Enemy Respawn: Enemies now respawn after saving at a lodestone (excluding bosses and mini-bosses).

🏛️ Arcane Spire:
Added a new playable area outside the Spire!
Made many changes to the inside layout.

🔥 Stackable Torches:Torches are now stackable.

🏃 Stamina Adjustment: Decreased the amount of stamina drained while sprinting.

⏩ Skip Cutscenes & Combat Tutorial:Added an option to skip cutscenes and the combat tutorial.

⚔️ Mini Boss Fight Adjustment: Improved the mini boss fight in the arcane spire, making it less clunky.

🎬New Introduction Cutscene:Added a voice-acted cutscene that provides story and lore, so players have context before diving in.

🐛 Bug Fixes: 


 Fixed an issue with the mouse being locked to the game window, preventing ALT + Tab.
 Fixed destructible meshes flying upon destruction.
 Fixed the settings menu not closing when unpausing with a keyboard (after unplugging a controller).
 Fixed a bug where the player's torch would sometimes duplicate in their hand.


I really wanted to get something out to you all. This is the first of two updates I've planned for this month. I'm currently working on the Enemy AI, a potion crafting/upgrading system, and reworking the last level of the demo since there isn't much gameplay in that level. I've got a lot of work to do on the actual game as well, so I'm not sure how many more updates I'll release for the demo. It all depends on the community feedback I receive! I'm not only making this game for me, but I'm also making it for you too! So any and all feedback is greatly appreciated! Again, I'm sorry it has taken me so long to even get a small update out! Between the baby, working on the game, and playing through and bug testing, it's all been very slow going. But I am hoping to pick up the pace here soon!

notes.title: Update! 2/28/2024 Controller support!
notes.content:
👋 Hello everyone! I hope all is well. I've been super busy trying to knock out this update, but it's finally finished! 🎉 Let me walk you through the exciting new features and improvements I've added to the game. 

🎮 Added full controller support for Microsoft/Playstation.
💥 Added destructible meshes to all boxes/barrels/etc.
🤖 Made slight adjustments to the enemy AI.
      Currently working on a complete AI overhaul, so please stay tuned!

⚔️ Added a death penalty. Players will now lose a percentage of Acurine Dust when killed.
🛠️ Fixed a bug where switching attack styles would be delayed.
🛠️ Fixed a bug causing a delay when interacting with items/chests.
🛠️ Fixed a bug causing a delay when trying to shoot an arrow immediately after ceasing to walk/run.
🧩 Added a new puzzle mechanic + New item.
🔥 Introducing torches! Yep! Torches :D Use these to solve puzzles. Previously, you would light your arrows, but since the Acurine Ice Shard gives you ice arrows, it didn't make sense to require the player to constantly unequip the ice shard to use the braziers! 🕯️🔥

Controller support took a little longer than expected, but I'm thrilled to announce that it's finally finished! 🎮 I can't wait for you all to try it out and provide your feedback. 😊 While I'm still hard at work on the next update with some cool new stuff, I couldn't contain my excitement about getting controller support into the demo. That's why I've decided to roll out this update in two parts! Stay tuned for part two, coming soon! 🚀🎉

notes.title: Update 2/8/2024
notes.content:
Thanks to all the feedback I've received, I've made a few changes and updated the demo build. I really do appreciate all the feedback I get, so please, if you have something you don't like about the game, or something you feel like I could have done better, or should not have done at all, no matter what the feedback is, I want to hear it! Here are the updates in the new patch:

Beginning Introduction: Shortened the introduction to the game. Cauna is no longer a playable level but a full-on cutscene instead. Entire scene revamped to be more fast-paced.

Bow Aiming Adjustment: Changed bow aiming mechanics. Previously, clicking the left mouse button aimed and shot, with the right mouse button releasing aim. Now, hold the right mouse button to aim and press the left mouse button to shoot.

Stamina Cost for Blocking/Parrying Removed: Blocking/parrying no longer costs stamina. Parrying an attack will now recover a small amount of health and stamina instead.

Combat Tutorial Revamp: Revamped the combat tutorial with cleaner widgets and a more fluid combat feel.

UI Adjustment: Moved the "Out Of Stamina" pop-up text to the bottom of the screen.

Atmosphere and Lighting Adjustments: Adjusted the atmosphere and lighting within the Arcane Spire.

Ranged Damage Increase: Increased ranged damage.

Crosshair Adjustment: Ranged crosshair will no longer spread/adjust when moving, making aiming easier.

Mage Enemies Adjustment: Adjusted mage enemies to prevent them from spamming channeling spells excessively, such as "Icy Winds," for a more enjoyable and fair fight.

Mini Boss Fix: Fixed a bug with the mini boss in the Arcane Spire where it failed to draw its weapon, resulting in attempts to attack with its fist, dealing no damage.

AI Changes: Adjusted the enemy AI to enhance responsiveness. A complete AI overhaul is planned for the future, stay tuned for further improvements!

Leveling Up/Acurine Dust Changes: Slightly decreased the Acurine cost for leveling stats.

Increased availability of Acurine Dust in the early game to introduce players to the leveling up system sooner.

I will continue to work on and improve the current state of things. My biggest goal is to create a game that is enjoyable to play, so again, I really appreciate all of the feedback. Thank you!

notes.title: Monthly Update: January/Steam Next Fest Approach!
notes.content:
With the Steam Next Fest on the horizon, I've been working tirelessly to bring you meaningful updates. Polishing the overall experience and prepping the demo for public release has been my top priority. Now, let's dive into the latest developments!

Acurine Lodestones: Work in progress with more features to come. These serve as new save points where players can interact, save the game, or level up using the new currency "Acurine Dust." No more auto stat gains – you're in control!

You can no longer pause the game to save; the option has been removed with the introduction of Acurine Lodestones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709306/3caac858beca3f3201d9f35cb7ad98d2177cc4fc.png

Acurine Dust: is the new in-game currency, and it is spent on stat points at the Acurine Lodestones. It will also be used as the in-game currency at the eventual vendor shops. Enemies will no longer give XP upon death; instead, they will drop Acurine Dust. XP still exists in the game and is found through Arcane scrolls in the arcane spire. You also gain XP for spending Acurine Dust at the Lodestones, allowing you to increase your character's level and +1 to the armor stat!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709306/158540f21bd42812c94d4ba4e06be5debd58fffd.png


Shields and Acurine Shards: Shields can now be used to block magic attacks
(they will only block, not parry). You must have a shield equipped to block magic attacks!

Alternatively, with an Acurine shard equipped, players will now be able to block and parry magic attacks, with or without a shield! But beware, there is a twist ;)

Acurine Ice Shard: can block and parry Poison spells; 
it can also parry fire spells. But not block them. making timing crucial!

Acurine Fire Shard can block/parry ice spells. But getting hit by a poison spell while using the Acurine fire spell will surely kill you, as it causes an explosion!

I'm still working on the Acurine Lightning shard and its part in all of this, so stay tuned!

Blocking a spell of the same element of magic as the Acurine shard you are using will grant the player a small healing effect or a critical strike buff, depending.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709306/4cb8ad1a6c85302fbb2f14651dfdc249e9818b8e.gif

Mage Enemies: Mage enemies now take 5% more overall damage from ranged attacks.

Chore Mechanics Tweaks:


 Attacking/Blocking now costs stamina.
This stamina drain will be less and less noticeable as you increase your dexterity stat and level up.
But does make the beginning of the game a tad more difficult!

 Drinking potions stops attacks, slows movement, and prevents further actions during the animation.
Previously, you were able to spam attacks while drinking potions, and it just did not feel very good to me. This also adds a lot to the difficulty, this is a Souls-like action-adventure game, after all ;)

 When the player is low on health, they will now play a hurt animation and move much slower than normal.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709306/2f3fd16eb09442000b67628de08ab2e499d431fb.png

 Mini-boss fight in the arcane spire revised – complete it with ranged attacks or melee after debuffing. Also added a new enemy to the boss fight, and visual improvements to the Arcane Spire as a whole. 

Enemy Outlines: Added outlines to enemies for better indication of when to dodge or parry attacks. Blue for parryable, red for unblockable.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709306/f91c799d25acbe2f2d3eb880ff9de1f003ba0e9f.gif

This mechanic is a work in progress and may become a difficulty option, potentially tied to a new Steam achievement. Cleaned up unnecessary game elements, removed widgets, and enhanced player immersion without drastic changes.

Adjusted the Lock-On Target Camera: Previously, the closer you got to a locked-on enemy, the higher the camera would adjust. The current angle just felt way too top-down to me, so it has been adjusted slightly.

Fixed an issue where the player couldn't use any inputs when trying to activate an Acurine ability and being damaged.

Added a photosensitivity warning at the beginning of the game. 
 This is to ensure the safety and well-being of players who may be sensitive to visual stimuli.

Fixed the photosensitivity warning showing up every time the player would return to the main menu. It will now only show once, upon first loading the game.

Stay tuned for more updates and get ready for the Steam Next Fest! 🎮

notes.title: Monthly Update: December
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I want to thank all of you for the support! as always, I greatly appreciate it!
I noticed that I always post the updates on the discord channel! and have neglected to post any of those updates here to steam, that said I will be posting all future updates here on steam! 

Here are the updates from December that those of you not in the discord would have missed!

PLEASE NOTE: I will also include the updates from today. As I have updated the build a few minutes ago! So check those out at the very bottom!


🧪Potion Slot Changes:
Out with the old "F" slot, in with the Acurine Ability slot!

❄️🔥⚡Acurine Abilities Unveiled:
There are currently five different Acurine Abilities, four of which change depending on whether you are using melee or ranged. These Acurine Abilities only share cooldowns for the respective Acurine shard. Meaning, you can use the Ice ability and still use the Fire ability while the Ice is on cooldown.

💰 Currency Swap:
Gold coins are out, added the new currency "Acurine Dust." More about this new currency and its uses will be revealed soon!

🎯🔄 Soft Targeting System Implementation:
Introducing a new soft targeting system! Responding to feedback that some testers don't use the tab key for locking on, I've developed a soft targeting feature. Upon attacking, the immediate area around the player will be scanned for enemies in range, and the system will soft lock onto the closest target. This functionality applies to all attacks, including light, heavy, break block, jump, as well as parrying and blocking. You can also dodge with the space bar while the soft lock is engaging. Fear not, this soft targeting does not replace the tab targeting "Hard lock," so you can still tab target as usual if you prefer.

🎯 Soft Targeting Smoothed:
Made a few adjustments to the soft targeting system, making it just a bit smoother!

🔄 Dodge/Rolling Dynamics Update! 🔄
With the advent of the new soft targeting system, players can now execute a roll by hitting the space bar while the soft target is engaged. This window lasts for approximately 1 second, providing strategic maneuverability during combat.
🔀 ALTERNATIVELY!
Players have gained the ability to Dodge/Roll by double-tapping W,A,S,D
For instance, swiftly tapping "D" twice consecutively allows the player to elegantly roll to the right! Master the art of evasion with these dynamic changes! 🌪️🏹


🏹 Ranged Challenges:
I've been trying to come up with a way to combat the player being able to kite enemies given they have enough arrows. I did not want to make ranged attacks cost stamina, so I've changed the ranged crosshair to change dynamically if the player is moving, making it just a little bit harder to land headshots.

⚡ Enhanced Lighting Arrows with Braziers! ⚡
I've made significant adjustments to how lighting arrows with braziers operate. Previously, you would light an arrow, get a timer, and had to patiently wait for the timer to expire before relighting your arrow.
Now, the process has been refined! You can re-light your arrow from the brazier at any time during the countdown timer. This means you have the flexibility to re-set the timer and relight your arrows whenever strategic necessity demands. Experience a more seamless and dynamic arrow-lighting mechanic! 🏹🔥

🤖 AI Improvements:
Reworked some of the AI in my ongoing process to overhaul all of the combat! Enemies will now feel a lot smarter to fight against! Gone are the days of being able to just mindlessly spam the light attack button and defeat your foes! 😉

Enemies now receive an Anim notify when attacking, rotating them towards the player. Previously, you were able to easily get behind enemies since they would not rotate during the root motion of their attacks.

Enemies will now try to lunge attack when the player is out of range or after they roll to evade an attack, given they are a far enough distance to trigger it.
Increased the percentage of the enemies' "Random Parry chance."

Enemies will now play more defensively after being blocked/parried and will also play more aggressively right after blocking/parrying.

Enemies now have a cooldown after finishing an attack combo, changing their behavior to play a little more defensively for a second. This helps with attack spam and also makes it feel a little better.

🏰 Arcane Spire Expansion:
New floor in the Arcane Spire with an elite enemy, mini-boss tweaks, and extra challenges!

The room also offers four braziers to light your arrows with; previously, it was only one. 🔥

💊 Enemy Health Changes
Removed the percentage values of enemy health. Now, only the health bar will show. This is mainly due to the combat overhaul I'm working on. Some enemies may have low health but hit like trucks, while others may have higher health but hit a little less heavily. So it just didn't look right to me showing the values.

🔧 Improved Inventory Interaction:🔧
Players can now swiftly close the inventory and pause menu by pressing the respective buttons twice or hitting "esc," streamlining the user experience during gameplay.

⚔️🔧Weapon Fixes and Enhancements:⚔️🔧
Addressed an issue where two-handed weapons prevented jumping even when sheathed. Now, proper functionality is restored, allowing seamless gameplay with two-handed weapons.

UPDATES TODAY: 1/6/2024

Quick fix on the main menu – no more button spam required when hitting "New Game"! It's smooth sailing now.

Now, for the fun stuff:

Blocking Update: Tired of feeling forced into dodging or chugging potions? Yeah, me too. Changed the blocking mechanism – Previously the chance for the players block to be broken was based off the players stamina vs the enemies stamina, resulting in parrying/blocking being pointless most of the time. I've reworked this and blocking/parrying is now a lot more impactful. 

Enemies telegraph block break attacks with a red skull icon, giving you a chance to dodge.

Jump Attack: It feels a hundred times better! No more missing because the enemy moved an inch. Landing where you want to land – what a concept!

Atmosphere Tweaks: Cauna and the Arcane Spire got a makeover. Checkpoints got visual upgrades too. I made a lot of changes to the spire; this is largely due to the mini boss being a giant frost mage skeleton. I wanted a fitting Atmosphere ;)  

New Enemies: Added some fresh faces to the Arcane Spire – spice things up a bit.

With the steam next fest approaching I'm trying to work as fast as possible, I've got a lot of stuff I would like to do before it gets here, so stay tuned for more updates! 

Some of the things I'm planning on having in the next update Include: 

🛠️ Next Layer of Polish: Gonna polish things up a bit. Because why not make it look even better?

🎮 Combat Tutorial Upgrade: The tutorial feels like staring at a screen of text – not my style. Planning to make it more interactive and engaging.

🗝️ Key Keeper Level Rework: This level needs more life! and as it's the last level of the demo I really want it to be awesome! 


FRIENDLY REMINDER!:  The kickstarter pre-launch page is live! So if you like the game and would like to support the development you should check it out and follow it HERE
